2023-11-05
Claimant reported a rear-end collision at a stop light and stated neck pain began within hours. Claim opened and

2023-11-07
Reviewed the police report, wihch places the claimant's vehicle at the secne and records the rear impact as

2023-11-11
Spoke with the claimant, who gave the same account of the collision as in the first report. No earlier injury to the neck
or upper back appears in the file.
2023-12-30
Witness statements and scene photos match the described sequence of events. The other driver confirmed the
impact and did not dispute how it happened.
2024-02-10
Inspected the claimant's vehicle. Rear bumper and trunk damage is consistent with the force of the reported impact.
No earlier damage to the vehicle is recorded in the file, and nothing suggests the damage predates the policy start.
2024-02-29
Claimant was referred for medical evaluation and diagnosed with whiplash. The reported injury is plausible for a
collision of this type.
2024-03-10
Treatment followed a typical course of physical therapy and home exercises. Claimant reports steady improvement
and fewer restrictions on daily activities.
2024-03-31
Checked prior claims and medical history for the same body area. No earlier injury to the neck or back is known.
2024-04-13
Follow-up call with claimant. Symptoms have tapered as expected, and the treating provider notes the recovery is on
track for the usual timeline.
2024-06-25
Reviewed the full file. Liability, vehicle damage, injury, and treatment all line up with the reported loss.
Recommending the claim proceed to settlement review.

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
